data.titleEn: L'ORÉAL PARIS REVITALIFT LASER RENEW ANTI-AGEING CREAM SPF20
data.name: L'ORÉAL PARIS REVITALIFT LASER RENEW ANTI-AGEING CREAM SPF20
data.description: Working to keep your skin looking youthful, L'Oréal Paris Revitalift Laser Renew Anti-Ageing Cream SPF20 fends off wrinkles and fine lines for a more even, plumper complexion. Protecting against the damaging effects of both UVA and UVB rays, the powerful, concentrated formula is rated SPF 20 and discourages unwanted pigmentation and discolouration. It’s enriched with LHA, which exfoliates gently for a brighter, smoother look while Pro-Xylane™ at a 3% concentration firms and reduces wrinkles. With this layered, triple action method, skin benefits from refining, firming and shielding effects and reaps the rewards in just four weeks.
